_about: Ecosystem adoption signals from public APIs and primary announcements. Each figure is a dated snapshot and they are NOT all the same date: the drift-prone fields (stars, npm, PyPI, crates) carry the `captured` date above, while the pinned counts and the named-brand endpoint-probe findings are preserved from their own earlier passes and change only when those passes re-run. Sources inline. Part of the State of UCP Q3 2026 report.
_captured_note: captured is the date of the drift-prone fields (stars, npm, PyPI, crates). It briefly read 2026-10-14; that was wrong, because every one of those fields is byte-identical to history/2026-10-11.json and nothing was re-measured that day. Two non-drift fields were corrected after that snapshot and carry their own provenance: named_brands_serving_ucp from the 2026-10-13 launch-partner re-probe, and musts_signatures recounted from the register and committed 2026-10-14 (SOU-003 records the recount against coverage.json; the figure is the same either way).
_testability_note: The four testability classes our register uses at 2026-04-08, recounted 2026-10-15 from conformance/requirements/2026-04-08 over MUST, MUST NOT, REQUIRED and SHALL rows. They sum to 385, the musts total for that tag. The previous fields testability_server 185, testability_agent_bound 90 and testability_process 89 summed to 364, which is the 2026-07-17 total; they were never recomputed after the 2026-04-08 tag was re-pointed to a25a4a24 on 2026-09-09, so the page arithmetic did not add up.

sources.github: api.github.com/repos/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/<repo> (star and dependent counts as of 2026-10-11; this line previously read 2026-07-17, which contradicted the captured date in this same file)
sources.brands_probe: direct GET /.well-known/ucp on 8 named launch partners at their www hosts; re-probed 2026-10-13, earlier probes 2026-07-17 and 2026-08-13. The apex hosts answer 301 to www under the probe policy, so the www host is the one measured.
